# Pigskin Journeyman

> Football-themed vacation rentals built by a former professional quarterback. Six houses in Green Bay WI, South Bend IN, Massillon OH, and Jim Thorpe PA. Every house is a full football experience: home cinema, hot tub, game room, and themed decor throughout. Book direct for the lowest price.

## Booking

- Website: https://www.pigskinjourneyman.com
- Book direct on the website for the best price. Also listed on Airbnb and Vrbo.
- All houses are available on Airbnb, Vrbo, and direct booking.
- Check-in: 4:00 PM. Check-out: 11:00 AM.
- Minimum stay: 2 nights (varies by date and event).
- Security deposit: $1,000 authorization hold ($2,000 for the Compound), released after checkout.
- Cancellation: direct bookings, 100% refund 30+ days before check-in, no refund within 30 days. Applies to all six properties. Airbnb is Strict. Vrbo varies by property.

## Pricing

Rates are dynamic and change by date, season, and local events (Packers home games, Notre Dame home games, Hall of Fame events). No fixed nightly rate is published because prices vary significantly by date. Guests see the exact price for their dates in the booking calendar on the website. Booking direct is always cheapest, about $25 per night less than Airbnb or Vrbo.

## Properties

### Lombardi House, Green Bay WI
- Address: 1601 Sue Lane, Green Bay, WI 54304
- 4 bedrooms, 11 beds, 2 baths, sleeps 14
- 0.7 miles from Lambeau Field, walkable to Packers games
- Hidden locker room, home theater, 7-seat hot tub, arcade, fire pit
- Best for: Packers game weekends, Green Bay stay, NFL fans
- Themes: Green Bay Packers, Vince Lombardi, NFL history

### Rockne House, South Bend IN
- Address: 2121 Rockne Drive, South Bend, IN 46617
- 5 bedrooms, 13 beds, 2 baths, sleeps 18
- 1 mile from Notre Dame Stadium
- 10-person hot tub, 110-inch cinema, pool table, Pop-A-Shot, fire pit
- Best for: Notre Dame game weekends, college football fans
- Themes: Notre Dame Fighting Irish, Knute Rockne, college football

### Rockne 2.0, South Bend IN
- Address: 2129 Rockne Drive, South Bend, IN 46617
- 4 bedrooms, 7 beds, 3.5 baths, sleeps 17
- 1 mile from Notre Dame Stadium
- Five-screen jumbotron sports bar, Finnish sauna, full gym, putting green, hot tub
- Best for: Notre Dame game weekends, large groups, sports bar experience
- Themes: Notre Dame, modern sports bar, USC rivalry

### Rockne Compound, South Bend IN
- Address: 2121 and 2129 Rockne Drive, South Bend, IN 46617
- 9 bedrooms, 22 beds, 5.5 baths, sleeps 35
- Both Rockne houses booked together
- Two hot tubs, two game zones, putting green, two cinemas
- Best for: large groups, weddings, team travel, Notre Dame weekends
- Per-guest fee: $25/night per guest above 16 guests

### Snubs House, Massillon OH
- Address: 820 State Avenue NE, Massillon, OH 44646
- 5 bedrooms, 13 beds, 2.5 baths, sleeps 16
- Near Pro Football Hall of Fame (Canton, about 15 minutes)
- In-ground pool, hot tub, cinema, gym, game room
- Best for: Hall of Fame visits, Ohio high school football, Massillon Tigers fans
- Themes: Pro Football Hall of Fame snubs, Massillon football history

### GOAT House, Jim Thorpe PA
- Address: 54 Indian Trail Road, Jim Thorpe, PA 18229
- 5 bedrooms, 11 beds, 4 baths, sleeps 14 (legal occupancy cap)
- In the Pocono Mountains, Bear Creek Lakes community
- Indoor basketball court, 135-inch cinema, 8-person hot tub, 12-foot barrel sauna, pro gym
- Golf cart available as an add-on for Bear Creek Lakes amenities
- Best for: Poconos getaway, Jim Thorpe history, group retreats
- Themes: Jim Thorpe, greatest athlete of all time, Olympic history

## What Makes These Different

- Every house is fully football themed, not just a few decorations.
- Home cinemas with large screens in every house.
- Hot tubs at every house.
- Game rooms with pool, Pop-A-Shot, arcade, and more.
- Built and operated by Matt Bassuener, former professional quarterback (Arena Football League, Team USA, Friday Night Lights stunt double, played Brett Favre in American Underdog).
- Direct booking is cheapest. No extra guest fees hidden at checkout.

## Nearby

- Lambeau Field (Green Bay): 0.7 miles from Lombardi House
- Notre Dame Stadium (South Bend): 1 mile from Rockne House and Rockne 2.0
- Pro Football Hall of Fame (Canton OH): about 15 minutes from Snubs House
- Jim Thorpe, PA: historic downtown, hiking, whitewater rafting, skiing nearby
